text:
Nora P: Heads-up from support: a customer sent a 100-item mixed-dim embeddings batch and got billed ~3x what Console showed. They hit quota and our support team got paged.
Sam R: Can we see the raw request?
Nora P: Short repro in logs: `inputs: [{dim:256}, {dim:2048}, ...]` (many varied). Console showed estimated units=120, runtime charged units=360.
Priya K: Runtime unit accounting uses max(dim) per sub-batch once we pack into GPU slices. Console's estimator is still doing avg-dim*count which undercounts for long-tail dims.
Alex (billing): That delta is causing disputes. We need a deterministic public estimator or explicit client-supplied units to avoid surprises.
Nora P: Customer suggested a preflight endpoint that returns an authoritative units estimate without executing the request. Thoughts?
Sam R: We already have a thin preflight in router but it's throttled and not exposed to Console due to cost. Exposing it naively could double load.
Priya K: Proposal: (1) implement a sampled preflight API (low QPS) that Console can call for canary/large requests; (2) add a client header `X-Embed-Units` for customers who want to self-declare units for billing; (3) change Console estimator to use a conservative `max(dim)` heuristic for mixed requests.
Alex (billing): `X-Embed-Units` is risky unless we validate server-side. We can accept it as advisory and bill based on runtime, but surface the declared value in invoices.
Sam R: Implementation detail: preflight should run the router's unit calc path only (no model execution). Add a cached result keyed by (tenant, route, dims_vector, count) for 10m to avoid hot loops. Also quota-limit preflight per-tenant (default 5/min) and require auth.
Priya K: For Console UX, we can: show the conservative estimate by default, but include a "Get authoritative estimate" button that calls preflight (with spinner) for large uploads. That keeps latency optional.
Nora P: Nice. And for SDKs, add an option to call preflight before sending a huge batch. We'll add examples to docs.
Sam R: Telemetry: emit `embed.preflight_hit` and `embed.preflight_miss` and `embed.estimator_delta` (histogram). Alert if >2% of requests >2x delta.
Priya K: Also update quota engine: when runtime charges exceed Console-estimated by >200% for a tenant for an hour, create a mitigation ticket and auto-enroll tenant in canary preflight for 24h.
Alex (billing): Add an invoice note when a tenant uses `X-Embed-Units` that we will reconcile declared vs actual units monthly and surface adjustments.
DevOps-bot: rollout plan queued: router/preflight-probe-service -> canary -> 2026-04-01T08:00Z
Nora P: Action items: Priya -> preflight service + cache + quota; Sam -> conservative estimator + Console button + telemetry; Alex -> billing consequences and invoice copy; Nora -> doc + support FAQ.
Sam R: I'll open the PRs and link designs. @Priya_K please review preflight QPS limits.
Priya K: Will do. Also we should log sample payload shapes (hashed) for debugging but not store raw inputs.
Nora P: Thanks all. Leaving thread open for PR links and canary results. :seedling:
